# WAJ Magazine

> New Jersey's leading independent culture magazine, featuring creatives, entrepreneurs, athletes, and community leaders since 2014.

WAJ Magazine (We Are Jersey Magazine) was founded in 2014 by Bridget Papino and Daniel Banks in Bergen County, New Jersey. We publish digital and print issues spotlighting the most compelling voices in New Jersey culture — from music artists and athletes to entrepreneurs and community advocates.

## About

- Founded: 2014
- Founders: Bridget Papino (CEO), Daniel Banks (Co-Founder)
- Headquarters: Bergen County, New Jersey, USA
- Parent company: We Are Jersey ENT LLC
- Website: https://wajmagazine.com
- Issues published: 42+ issues (Issue 001 through Issue 042)
- Coverage area: New Jersey and the greater New York metropolitan area

## What We Cover

- Music: Hip-hop, R&B, Jersey Club, gospel, and emerging NJ artists
- Community: Local activists, nonprofit leaders, educators, and changemakers
- Business: Entrepreneurs, startup founders, and small business owners
- Sports: Professional and amateur athletes with NJ connections
- Fashion & Lifestyle: Designers, stylists, and tastemakers
- Food & Hospitality: Chefs, restaurateurs, and culinary innovators
- Culture: Arts, events, and the people shaping New Jersey's identity

## Notable Cover Subjects

Issue 042: Honey Bxby, DJ Taj | Issue 041: DJ Smallz 732, Qaysean Williams | Issue 040: The Artist, Lady Luck | Issue 039: Shakur Stevenson | Issue 038: Mapy | Issue 037: Malcolm Jenkins Foundation | Issue 036: Frankie Edgar x Tobias Eats | Issue 035: Pilar Scratch & River Mason, Trey Budden | Issue 033: Uniiqu3

## Mission

WAJ Magazine exists to amplify the voices of the people doing real work in their communities — the creatives, the entrepreneurs, the athletes, and the advocates who don't always get the spotlight they deserve. We believe every community has stories worth telling.
